subject: project:gdl
value: THREE DEFECTS MEASURED IN THE RUN-50 PROMOTION LANE at 1370dce50, each with its one-command reproduction and its verbatim output. The fix belongs to the tools/gdl owner; the measurement is here so it is not a paraphrase. (1) savedregs' `ROWS THIS TABLE CANNOT SEE` COUNT IS COMPUTED ON RENDERED OPERAND TEXT, SO POOL-NAME NOISE INFLATES IT INTO A FABRICATED VOLATILE RESIDUAL. `python tools/gdl/savedregs.py game/world/newcam fn_8006E654 --raw` prints `ROWS THIS TABLE CANNOT SEE: 25 differing instruction row(s) at aligned offsets touch NO callee-saved register at all -- a volatile-register residual, which is what three records mistook this table's all-clear for.` The function's ENTIRE residual is one word: `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_word_diff.py game/world/newcam fn_8006E654` reads `369 insns, DIFFERING WORDS = 1, MNEMONIC DIVERGENCE = 0, RELOC-SYMBOL MISMATCH = 0` with `DECODE: REGFIELD-ONLY 1`. Reading the aligned view (`python tools/gdl/fnasm.py game/world/newcam fn_8006E654 --diff --raw`) resolves it: 27 rows are non-equal, 1 is the real recolor at +0x3c (`addi r30,r29,0` vs `li r30,0`) and the other 26 are byte-identical `lfd` loads whose RELOCATION SYMBOL renders as `@lbl_80347458(EMB_SDA21)` on the target side and `@@44(EMB_SDA21)` on ours -- the named-pool noise AGENTS.md already documents as the reason `fndiff --clean` exists. This line is the one the tool's own docstring wrote to stop a lane misreading an all-clear, and on a pinned recolor it now manufactures the opposite error: a 1-word function advertised as carrying a 25-row volatile-colour cascade. The fix is to compare the ENCODED WORD (or route through fndiff's `_datum_prefix_equal`) rather than the rendered text, exactly as the wrong-symbol screen does. (2) probe --raw REPORTS `RAW WORDS: not measurable -- count-asymmetric` ON A COUNT-SYMMETRIC FUNCTION. `python tools/gdl/probe.py game/game/combat cam_orient_to_80029E8C --raw --ops` prints `BASELINE real 4 (insns T102/O102, multiset 0t)` and, two lines later, `[RAW WORDS: not measurable -- the two streams are count-asymmetric, or the raw body could not be read. A count-asymmetric function is outside every postprocessor class by construction, so there is no word residual to arbitrate on.]` -- while `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_word_diff.py game/game/combat cam_orient_to_80029E8C` on the same tree reads `102 insns, DIFFERING WORDS = 2 ... DECODE: REGFIELD-ONLY 2`. T102/O102 is not asymmetric, so the disjunctive message is firing on its second branch (the raw body could not be read) while ASSERTING the first, and the assertion is the one that ends a lane's inquiry. probe.py's own comment at raw_word_residual names the mechanism: it bails when the object it measured is not `fnasm.raw_obj_path(unit)`, which prefers the `frank` stage while `--raw` built the `body` stage. The same call on game/enemy/critter (`probe.py game/enemy/critter CritterLineNodeColSub --raw`) prints `RAW WORDS = 6 of 75 insns` correctly, so this is per-TU, not global -- which is worse, because it looks like a property of the function. The message should distinguish the two branches and name the two paths it compared. (3) PROPOSAL GATE G FIRES ON A RECORD THAT QUOTES probe.py's OWN OUTPUT. `propose-record` refused attempt.PR_critterlinenodecolsub-...20260903.v1 with `a record closing the POSTPROCESSOR path for a function (matched 'outside every postprocessor class') must enumerate WHICH verifiers ran, in verifiers_run`. The matched phrase was a quotation of the sentence probe --raw and wf_word_diff both PRINT (`A count-asymmetric function is outside every postprocessor class by construction`), used in a `count_consequence` field to say a probed form was not a candidate keep -- in a record that did no rule work, ran no verifier, and left the shipped rule untouched. This is the same false-positive class AGENTS.md already records for the run-44 slot-arbiter gate, whose first EVIDENCE predicate `looked only for the literal tool name and scored eight records as violations that quote the tool's OUTPUT verbatim`. The trigger needs the same exclusion: a phrase inside a quotation of a tool's own message is not the record asserting it. Rewording the field cleared the gate with no change of meaning, which is the definition of a trigger that costs a submission and buys nothing.
